questions.question: In ΔABC, if BC = AB and ∠B = 80°, then the value of ∠A is:
questions.explanation: Since BC = AB, ∠A = ∠C. Let them be x. x + x + 80 = 180 => 2x = 100 => x = 50°.

questions.question: If ΔABC ≅ ΔFDE, and it is given that AB = 5 cm, ∠A = 80°, ∠B = 40°, then the value of ∠E is:
questions.explanation: Matching vertices: A-F, B-D, C-E. ∠C = 180 - (80+40) = 60°. Since ΔABC ≅ ΔFDE, ∠E = ∠C = 60°.

questions.question: In triangles ABC and PQR, AB = AC, ∠C = ∠P and ∠B = ∠Q. The two triangles are:
questions.explanation: Both triangles have angles that make them isosceles (∠B=∠C and ∠P=∠Q), but AAA is not a congruence criterion, so they aren't necessarily congruent without a side length.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if AD is the bisector of ∠A, which of the following is always true?
questions.explanation: In ΔABD, exterior ∠ADB = ∠C + ∠CAD = ∠C + ∠BAD. So ∠ADB > ∠BAD. Thus AB > BD.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if ∠A = 40° and ∠B = 60°, which side is the longest?
questions.explanation: ∠C = 180 - (40+60) = 80°. Side AB is opposite to the largest angle ∠C, so AB is the longest side.

questions.question: Show that the angles of an equilateral triangle are 60° each.
solutionSteps: In an equilateral triangle ABC, AB = BC = AC.
Since AB = AC, ∠C = ∠B. Since AC = BC, ∠B = ∠A.

questions.question: ABC is an isosceles triangle with AB = AC. AD is perpendicular to BC. Prove ∠BAD = ∠CAD.
solutionSteps: In right triangles ADB and ADC, AB = AC (Given hypotenuse).

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if the bisector AD of Angle A is perpendicular to side BC, prove triangle ABC is isosceles.
solutionSteps: In ΔABD and ΔACD, ∠BAD = ∠CAD (AD is bisector).
By CPCT, AB = AC. Thus isosceles.

questions.question: P is a point on the bisector of Angle ABC. If light through P parallel to BA meets BC at Q, prove triangle BPQ is isosceles.
solutionSteps: In ΔBPQ, sides opposite these equal angles are equal: PQ = BQ.

questions.question: In quadrilateral ABCD, AB = BC and AD = CD. Show that BD bisects the angle ABC.
solutionSteps: In ΔABD and ΔCBD, AB = BC (Given).
By SSS, ΔABD ≅ ΔCBD. By CPCT, ∠ABD = ∠CBD.
